content.instructions: Every German noun is masculine, feminine or neuter, and is written with a capital letter. The definite article (the) shows the gender: der, die or das. In the plural it is always die. Learn each noun with its article.
text:
Definite articles (nominative)
GenderListenArticleExample
masculinederder Name, der Vorname
femininediedie Stadt, die Nationalität
neuterdasdas Land, das Alter
pluraldiedie Namen, die Länder
Der Name ist Vogel. Die Stadt heißt Graz. Das Land heißt Österreich.
